title: TOCTOU race in temp-file creation allows symlink attack
description: write_cache() in cache/store.py checks os.path.exists(path) and then opens the path for writing in a separate step. Between the check and the open, a local attacker can swap in a symlink, causing the process to overwrite an arbitrary file with the cache contents. Use os.open with O_CREAT and O_EXCL instead.
poc_text: Race the gap between the exists() check and the open() with a symlink pointing at a target file.
